unclear.text: Whether the 65% threshold counts sugar against dry weight or total weight (assumed total weight, the reading more favorable to importers of syrups and blends).
readings: U1-a: the threshold counts sugar against total weight (assumed)
U1-b: the threshold counts sugar against dry weight

a1.text: Without the quota, Calvar would keep importing well over 350,000 tonnes a year, so the quota binds from the first year, and more tightly as demand grows.

a2.text: Customs enforces the quota at the ports.

a6.text: Importers know the allocation formula during the window and can finance and store extra imports.

a8.text: Importing blends and syrups with 65% sugar or less is technically and commercially workable for some users.

a12.text: Bulk sugar is smuggled on a meaningful scale.

a22.text: The customs budget is raised to cover inspection of bulk shipments and the register of quota rights.
